text:
Elena: Hey team — I'm opening my first PR to tweak an HTTP header in the serving runtime. Quick questions: do we have a short reviewer checklist, branch naming rules, and which CI failures are absolute blockers vs flaky so I know what to fix vs rerun?

Kevin: Welcome! Branching: use `feat/<yourname>/<short-desc>` for features or `fix/<yourname>/<short>` for bugfixes. Target branch is `main`. Keep PRs small when possible (aim <400 lines).

Sam: Local prechecks: run `pre-commit run --all-files` and `make test` (or `./scripts/test.sh` for runtime quick-tests). We gate on linters, mypy, and unit tests — those are hard blockers.

Oliver: CODEOWNERS will auto-suggest reviewers for runtime changes (I and @sarah cover `./runtime/**`). If it touches API surface, add @Kevin explicitly. For infra changes ping @eng-infra.

Jen: Docs note: add a one-line "Docs" section in the PR body if it's user-visible, and update `CHANGELOG.md` under Unreleased if appropriate.

Kevin: CI details: blocker jobs — `lint`, `mypy`, `runtime-smoke`. Flaky-ish jobs — `integration-db` and `perf-smoke` (these sometimes fail on timeouts). If only the flakey ones fail, add a comment `@eng-oncall can you re-run?` and bump the CI.

devex-bot: Reminder: PR footer must include DCO signoff (Signed-off-by: Your Name <email>) or the bot will request changes. Also link a ticket (`/no-ticket` allowed but include context).

Elena: Nice, thanks. How should I request reviewers — GitHub sidebar + Slack ping or something else?

Sam: GitHub reviewers in the sidebar first, then drop the PR link in #devex with a one-liner. Example: `Elena: PR https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/123 — small runtime header fix, needs 1 reviewer`. If urgent, add :rotating_light: and tag @eng-sre or the oncall.

Oliver: Tip: mark PR as Draft while iterating. Set `reviewers` to 1-2 and label size (`size/S`, `size/M`) so folks triage it faster. If you change build configs, also ping me directly.

Elena: Perfect — I'll push a branch `feat/elena/runtime-header-tidy` and follow the checklist. Thanks everyone!
